Perfect! All tests are now passing. 

**Root cause:** The `bulk_discount` function in `shopcart/pricing.py` was using `qty > BULK_THRESHOLD` instead of `qty >= BULK_THRESHOLD`. This meant the discount was not applied when the quantity exactly matched the threshold (qty=10), only when it exceeded it.

**Fix applied:** Changed the comparison operator from `>` to `>=` so the 10% bulk discount applies correctly at and above the threshold of 10 units.
